decision_conditions: The proposed outbuilding, when considered in conjunction with the existing outbuilding and single storey rear extension, would result in excessive built form within the rear garden. The combined scale and massing would create an overly dominant form of development that would fail to respect the pattern of development in the immediately surrounding context. The proposal is therefore contrary to Section 12 of the National Planning Policy Framework (2024), Policies D4 and D5 of the London Plan (2021), Policy CP30 of the Enfield Core Strategy (2010), and Policies DMD6, DMD12 and DMD37 of the Enfield Development Management Document (2014).

The proposed outbuilding when considered in conjunction with the existing outbuilding and single storey rear extension, would result in an almost continuous wall of development along the common boundary with No. 69 Vera Avenue. This would result in an unacceptably heightened sense of enclosure and an overbearing impact for the neighbouring occupiers. The proposal is therefore contrary to Section 12 of the National Planning Policy Framework (2024), Policies D4 and D5 of the London Plan (2021), Policies CP4 and CP30 of the Enfield Core Strategy (2010), and Policies DMD12 and  DMD37 of the Enfield Development Management Document (2014).
